title: Definitions.
bodyText: For the purposes of this part, "domestic violence" shall have the same meaning as "domestic abuse" as defined in section 586-1.
bodyHtml: [§521-79]  Definitions.  For the purposes of this part, "domestic violence" shall have the same meaning as "domestic abuse" as defined in section 586-1. [L 2015, c 220, pt of §1]
